study_scope: Paired development calibration of two shared changes: noninitial IK normalization and source-flow-triggered receiver pushes. Uses frozen easy-trained BC3; no new policy is trained.
difficulty_decision: Calibration target not met. No formal study, training, or automatic difficulty tuning is launched.
limits: Paired five known development recipes, not new heldout; tiny groupn5 Wilsonintervals reported

temporal_fidelity.cause: The inherited timestamp-floor history selector chooses an observed sample at or before the requested cutoff; archived age can exceed40ms.
temporal_fidelity.formal_protocol_prerequisite: Separate deterministic observed-history selection correctness fix and CPU oracle, shared by teacher/student. Do not interpolate fictional observed frames. No such fix is executed in this pilot.

action_mapping_diagnostic.scope: One CPU evaluation of frozen old BC3 and the exact clipped teacher formula on existing archived observed inputs, including expert and student visited states.
action_mapping_diagnostic.primary_error: Actual runtime clipping before the common action noise; raw unclipped policy errors also reported.
action_mapping_diagnostic.quantile_definition: 95th/max of absolute component errors pooled across three axes and all samples; per-sample vector L2 is separate.
action_mapping_diagnostic.clipping_definition: Fraction of raw teacher components strictly beyond the action limit and fraction of samples with any such component.
action_mapping_diagnostic.boundary: Strong low-level IK and scripted pickup/return remain. The upstream goal tracks actual cup XY; observations directly expose delayed goal errors and feedforward. Equal easy-task success is not evidence of DAgger, OPD, ICL, or recovery learning.
